hoaxes.title: DeepSeek's Super-agent will also order the team lunch when a group chat runs too long
hoaxes.truth: Made up. DeepSeek's open-source Super-agent watches GitHub repos and team chats and replies with pull requests.

hoaxes.title: Laika will let Wildwood ticket holders borrow one of the film's stop-motion puppets for a weekend
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Laika's Wildwood fell only 39% over Halloween weekend, taking $7.4 million in third place.

hoaxes.title: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2 adds a mode where Navi speaks in your own recorded voice
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time launches November 5 with new visuals, orchestral music and voice acting.

hoaxes.title: Apple is giving every Apple Store visitor a free AirTag to celebrate passing Nvidia
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Apple closed October 30 worth $5.03 trillion, passing Nvidia's $4.93 trillion as chip stocks fell.
